posts.title: Виды оптических патч-кордов - какие бывают и как выбрать

posts.title: Release of the django-markdown-html-field battery
posts.description: I have already written articles on how to create a MarkdownField for Django with auto populate functionality. But now I have packaged it as a standalone package for use in Django, which I am sharing with the Django community. You will find the project repository on GitHub: django_markdown_html_field And you can install the package from PyPi: django-markdown-html-field Functionality django_markdown
